svg.text: The best energies at each estimated cost in FLOPs, instance by instance
Every published energy whose paper states enough to estimate its optimisation in floating-point operations, on the 13
instances with at least two such rows. The line is the frontier: the results nothing beats for less. Colour is the kind of
number; filled marks can hold a record, hollow ones cannot.
exact: −0.503810 (ED), no cost stated, not drawn
exact: −0.560373 (ED), no cost stated, not drawn
exact (stochastic): −0.628656 (SSE QMC), no cost stated, not drawn
exact (stochastic): −0.671553 (SSE QMC), no cost stated, not drawn
exact (stochastic): −0.643532 (SSE QMC), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.766230 (ACE), no cost stated, not drawn
exact: −0.851370 (ED), no cost stated, not drawn
exact: −0.529310 (ED), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.758652 (VAFQMC (stripe λ = 8)), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.498963 (RBM + PP), no cost stated, not drawn
Every mark is an estimate: iterations × samples × (connected configurations + sampler passes + 3) × forward-pass FLOPs, from the counts the
paper states; the optimizer's solve, symmetry projections and pre-training are not counted, and the model is good to an order of magnitude. 6
of these estimates needed an assumption about the architecture. Labels marked QMBL are QMBL's own reference runs (6 rows).
